_note:
Regen (needs python3): ./scripts/text.sh --dump-golden-cases > /tmp/text-regen.json && python3 - /tmp/text-regen.json scripts/fixtures/text-goldens.json <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
dump = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
env = dict(subprocess.os.environ)
for kv in sys.argv[3:]:
    k, v = kv.split("=", 1)
    env[k] = v
p = subprocess.run(["python3", "-c", dump["prog"]], input=json.dumps(dump["cases"]),
                   capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr[:500]
truth = json.loads(p.stdout)
assert len(truth) == len(dump["cases"]), (len(truth), len(dump["cases"]))
try:
    old = json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
    note = old["_note"]
except FileNotFoundError:
    note = "NOTE-MISSING"
pyver = subprocess.run(["python3", "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env).stdout.strip()
json.dump({"_note": note, "python": pyver, "truth": truth}, open(sys.argv[2], "w"))
print(f"wrote {sys.argv[2]}: {len(truth)} rows with {pyver}")
EOF
